name: nyan
label: Nyan Runway
_note: A pixel cat flying across a sky beside the notice, laying the trail it is known for; its legs and tail animate as a frame swap, the way the original's do. The notice is held out of the lane so the two never overlap, and the card is glass so the trail passes behind it rather than through the words. The one style that pins its own palette: its colour is the point of it, and a customer's brand palette would leave nothing of it behind. Tone still reaches the pill, the mark and the glow -- a critical verdict is not softened here either.
